scope: A language-only implementation comparison on two existing regression datasets, not a new retrieval-quality study.
timing: Sequential fresh workers on one hosted Ubuntu 24.04 VM. No generation model. Native recall and real official-SDK stdio MCP are distinct measurement boundaries. Report each cohort and surface separately.
execution: One first-attempt hosted execution on validation/native-language-formal-1. Preserve every started attempt, completed worker and failure. No selective reruns or replacement of timed data.
resources: Record startup, ingestion, unchanged reingestion, process memory/CPU and storage alongside the paired recall measurements. Python and operating-system caches are not cleared.
decision: Exact full-output/source/index equality and release gates are mandatory. Interpret repeatability across all four paired rounds, retain regressions, and do not infer whole-product speed from helper microbenchmarks.
